title: Double passage: Hotel booking and complaint
passage:
【Document 1: Booking confirmation】
Riverside Grand Hotel
Guest: Mr. Samuel Owusu
Booking date: February 12
Check-in: March 3   Check-out: March 6 (3 nights)
Room: Deluxe King, river view, non-smoking
Rate: $180 per night (breakfast included)
Breakfast: served daily from 6:30 A.M. to 10:30 A.M. in the Garden Restaurant
Check-in time: from 3:00 P.M.
Note: Free cancellation until 48 hours before arrival.
Please present this confirmation at the front desk upon arrival.
Hotel facilities: outdoor pool (7:00 A.M. to 9:00 P.M.), fitness center, and business center on the second floor.
Late check-out: available until 1:00 P.M. on request.

【Document 2: E-mail】
From: Samuel Owusu
To: Guest Services, Riverside Grand Hotel
Date: March 7
Subject: My recent stay

Dear Guest Services,

I stayed at your hotel from March 3 to 6. Overall, the staff were friendly and the breakfast was excellent. The restaurant staff were especially helpful when I asked for a table near the window each morning, and the lobby was quiet even on the busy weekend. The housekeeping team also kept the corridors tidy, and I appreciated that. I was in the city for a conference on urban planning, and I chose your hotel because it is close to the conference center. The conference ran for three days, and I spent most of my time in meetings, so I mainly needed a comfortable place to sleep and work. However, the room I was given faced the parking lot, not the river, even though I had specifically booked a river view. I selected that option on your website on February 12, and I still have the confirmation I received. When I mentioned this at the front desk, I was told no other rooms were available. I was disappointed, since I had planned to recommend your hotel to my colleagues at the conference.

I understand that hotels are sometimes full, but I was charged the full rate for all three nights. I would appreciate it if you could refund the difference between a river-view room and a standard room. The clerk at the front desk said she would pass my complaint on to the manager, but I have not heard from anyone since I checked out on March 6. Since I have stayed with your hotel several times before, I hope this matter can be resolved quickly. I have kept all my booking records and receipts, and I am happy to send copies if you need them. I would also like to know whether the hotel's policy allows guests to change rooms during their stay when the room they are given does not match their booking. Please reply to me at this address.

Sincerely,
Samuel Owusu
translation:
【文書1:予約確認】リバーサイド・グランドホテル/宿泊者:サミュエル・オウス様/予約日:2月12日/チェックイン3月3日、チェックアウト3月6日(3泊)/客室:デラックスキング、川側、禁煙/料金:1泊180ドル(朝食込み)/朝食:毎朝午前6時30分〜10時30分、1階のガーデンレストランで提供/チェックイン時間:午後3時から/注:到着48時間前まで無料キャンセル可。/到着時はフロントでこの確認書をご提示ください。/ホテルの設備:屋外プール(午前7時〜午後9時)、フィットネスセンター、2階のビジネスセンター/延長チェックアウト:要望により午後1時まで可能

【文書2:メール】先日の宿泊について
3月3日から6日まで宿泊しました。全体としてスタッフは親切で、朝食もすばらしかったです。レストランのスタッフは、毎朝窓際の席を頼むと快く応じてくれました。週末の混雑時でもロビーは静かでした。客室清掃の係も廊下をきれいに保っており、ありがたく思いました。私は都市計画の会議で市内に来ており、会議場の近くにあるという理由でこちらのホテルを選びました。会議は3日間続き、私は大半の時間を会議で過ごしたので、主に快適に眠って仕事ができる場所が必要でした。しかし、川側の部屋をはっきり予約したにもかかわらず、案内された部屋は駐車場側でした。川側の部屋は2月12日にウェブサイトで選び、その確認書は今も手元にあります。フロントで伝えたところ、ほかに空いている部屋はないと言われました。同僚の参加者にもこちらのホテルを勧めるつもりだったので、残念でした。
ホテルが満室のこともあるのは理解しますが、3泊とも正規料金を請求されました。川側の部屋と標準の部屋の差額を返金していただけるとありがたいです。フロントの係員は支配人に伝えると言いましたが、3月6日にチェックアウトしてから、まだ誰からも連絡がありません。以前にも何度かこちらに宿泊しているので、早急に解決していただけるとありがたいです。予約の記録と領収書はすべて保管していますので、必要であればコピーをお送りします。また、予約と違う部屋を案内された場合に、滞在中に部屋を変えられるのかどうかも教えてください。このアドレスに返信をお願いします。

questions.question: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
questions.explanation: 川側の部屋と標準の部屋の差額の返金を求めている。

questions.question: What did Mr. Owusu like about his stay?
questions.explanation: スタッフは親切で朝食もすばらしかったと書いている。

questions.question: How much did Mr. Owusu pay in total for his room?
questions.explanation: 予約確認に1泊180ドルで3泊とあり、メールで3泊とも正規料金を請求されたとあるので、180×3=540ドル。

questions.question: What problem did Mr. Owusu experience?
choices: His reservation could not be found.
He did not receive the type of room he booked.
questions.explanation: 川側の部屋を予約したのに駐車場側の部屋だった。2つの文書を合わせて判断する。

questions.question: What is indicated about the hotel's cancellation policy?
choices: Guests can cancel for free up to two days before arrival.
Guests cannot cancel once they have booked.
Guests must pay one night's rate to cancel.
It applies only to river-view rooms.
questions.explanation: 予約確認に到着48時間前まで無料キャンセル可とある。

title: Text message chain: Stuck in traffic
passage:
Daniel Moss (9:12 A.M.): Hi, Elena. I'm stuck in traffic on the highway. There was an accident, and nothing is moving. I don't think I'll make it to the client meeting at ten.

Elena Ruiz (9:13 A.M.): I hope nobody was hurt. Have you been waiting long?

Daniel Moss (9:13 A.M.): About forty minutes so far. The radio says the highway may stay closed for a while.

Elena Ruiz (9:14 A.M.): Oh no. Should I ask them to start a little later?

Daniel Moss (9:15 A.M.): That would help, but I'm not sure how long this will take. Could you start the presentation without me? The slides are in the shared folder. Look for the file called "Q3 Proposal."

Elena Ruiz (9:16 A.M.): Sure, I know the material well. I'll cover the first half, and you can join when you arrive.

Daniel Moss (9:17 A.M.): Perfect. I'll call you as soon as I'm moving again. Thanks so much.

Elena Ruiz (9:18 A.M.): Please drive safely and don't rush. Everyone here is already in the conference room, so there's no need to hurry. The client's director, Ms. Hart, is running a few minutes late too.

Daniel Moss (9:19 A.M.): Thanks, Elena. I owe you one. I'll be there as soon as I can.

Elena Ruiz (9:20 A.M.): Will do. Let me know when you get close, and I'll come down to the lobby to meet you.

Daniel Moss (9:21 A.M.): That would be great. I'll message you as soon as I'm close to the building.
translation:
ダニエル・モス(午前9時12分):やあ、エレナ。高速道路で渋滞に巻き込まれているんだ。事故があって全然動かない。10時の顧客との会議には間に合わないと思う。

エレナ・ルイス(午前9時13分):大丈夫?けがをした人はいないといいけど。もう長く待っているの?

ダニエル・モス(午前9時13分):今のところ40分くらいだ。ラジオでは、しばらく高速道路が通行止めのままらしい。

エレナ・ルイス(午前9時14分):大変。少し遅らせて始めるよう頼んだほうがいい?

ダニエル・モス(午前9時15分):助かるけど、どのくらいかかるかわからないんだ。僕抜きでプレゼンを始めてくれる?スライドは共有フォルダにあるよ。「Q3 Proposal」というファイルを探してね。

エレナ・ルイス(午前9時16分):いいわよ、内容はよくわかっているから。前半を私が担当するから、着いたら加わって。

ダニエル・モス(午前9時17分):完璧だ。また動き出したらすぐ電話するよ。本当にありがとう。

エレナ・ルイス(午前9時18分):安全運転でね、急がないで。ここにいるみんなはもう会議室にいるから、焦る必要はないわ。顧客側の責任者であるハートさんも数分遅れているの。

ダニエル・モス(午前9時19分):ありがとう、エレナ。借りができたね。できるだけ早く着くよ。

エレナ・ルイス(午前9時20分):わかったわ。近くまで来たら教えて。ロビーまで迎えに下りるから。

ダニエル・モス(午前9時21分):助かるよ。ビルの近くに着いたらすぐ連絡する。

questions.question: Why will Mr. Moss be late?
choices: He is stuck in traffic because of an accident.
His car broke down on the highway.
questions.explanation: 事故があって高速道路の渋滞に巻き込まれていると書いている。

questions.question: What does Mr. Moss ask Ms. Ruiz to do?
choices: Pick him up from the highway
questions.explanation: 自分抜きでプレゼンを始めてくれるよう頼んでいる。

questions.question: At 9:16 A.M., what does Ms. Ruiz most likely mean when she writes, "I know the material well"?
choices: She has already read the client's report.
She wants to change the slides.
She is confident she can present the content.
She has attended many meetings with the client.
questions.explanation: プレゼンを始めてほしいという依頼に対し、内容をよく知っているので自分が発表できると伝えている。直後に前半を担当すると言っている。

Notes: Business casual dress is recommended for all events. Please bring a copy of your slides on a USB drive as a backup. Transportation: A driver will meet you at the arrival gate on October 9. Speakers' Lounge: light refreshments are available on Friday from 8:00 A.M. to 10:00 A.M.

【Document 2: E-mail】
From: Daniel Ortiz, Forum Coordinator
To: Akiko Mori
Date: October 2
Subject: Change to your schedule

Dear Ms. Mori,

I am writing to let you know about a change to your itinerary. Because the main hall is needed for a sponsor's product launch on Friday morning, your keynote speech has been moved to 1:30 P.M. on the same day. As a result, lunch with our sponsors will now take place at 11:30 A.M. in the hotel restaurant instead. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. The vegetarian meal you requested will still be served. Our staff will also provide a printed copy of the revised schedule at the registration desk. Please note that the keynote will still be recorded for our online audience.

All other events remain unchanged. The welcome dinner on Thursday is still at 7:00 P.M. in Room C. The panel discussion on Friday afternoon is also unchanged. A driver will meet you at the arrival gate and take you directly to the hotel. Your room has been reserved from October 9 through October 11, and the hotel has been told about your arrival time. If you need anything else before your trip, please let me know. Please send your keynote slides to our technical team by October 8 so they can be loaded before the event. If you would like a short rehearsal on the main stage, please let us know by October 6. I know this change may affect your preparation, so please let me know if you need any help adjusting your presentation. You may also contact me directly at extension 214 or at daniel.ortiz@pacificretail.example.

Best regards,
Daniel Ortiz

title: Double passage: Invoice and e-mail

BRIGHTLINE OFFICE SUPPLY

Item                         Qty   Unit price   Total

Ergonomic desk chair           4    $210.00     $840.00
Delivery                                         $40.00
TOTAL                                         $1,830.00

Payment due within 30 days. Orders over $1,500 qualify for free delivery. Please quote the invoice number on your payment. Late payments are subject to a fee of 2% per month. Thank you for your business. Brightline Office Supply has been serving local businesses since 1994. Prices include tax where applicable. Office chairs are covered by a two-year manufacturer's warranty.

【Document 2: E-mail】
From: Lucy Chen, Harper Architecture
To: Billing Department, Brightline Office Supply
Date: May 8
Subject: Invoice #48217

Hello,

We received our order yesterday, thank you. Everything arrived in good condition, and the delivery staff were very polite. However, I noticed two problems with the invoice. First, we ordered three desk chairs, not four, and only three were delivered. Second, we were charged for delivery, even though our order should qualify for the free delivery offer. Even with three chairs, our order comes to more than $1,500, so it should qualify. Our original purchase order, which I have attached, clearly lists three chairs at $210 each.

We have worked with Brightline for several years and have always been pleased with your service. This is the first time we have had a billing problem, so we hope it can be fixed quickly. Our finance team has already checked the delivery note, which also shows three chairs.

Could you please send us a corrected invoice? The chairs are for our new drafting room, and our accounts team closes the books at the end of the month, so a quick reply would be appreciated. We will make the payment as soon as we receive it. Please send the revised invoice to my e-mail address, lucy.chen@harperarch.example, rather than to the general mailbox. Thank you in advance for your help.

Best regards,
Lucy Chen
Office Manager

支払期限は30日以内。1500ドルを超えるご注文は配送無料。お支払いの際は請求書番号をお書きください。支払いが遅れた場合は、月2%の延滞料がかかります。ご利用ありがとうございます。ブライトライン事務用品は1994年から地域の企業にサービスを提供しています。価格は該当する場合、税込みです。オフィスチェアはメーカーの2年保証の対象です。

【文書2:メール】請求書番号48217について
昨日注文品を受け取りました。ありがとうございます。商品は無事に届き、配送担当の方もとても丁寧でした。ただ、請求書に2つ問題があります。まず、注文したデスクチェアは4脚ではなく3脚で、届いたのも3脚だけでした。次に、無料配送の対象になるはずなのに配送料が請求されています。3脚に直しても注文総額は1500ドルを超えるので、対象になるはずです。元の注文書(添付しています)にも、椅子は1脚210ドルで3脚と明記されています。

訂正した請求書を送っていただけますか。チェアは新しい製図室用で、経理は月末に締めの処理をするため、早めにご返信いただけるとありがたいです。受け取り次第すぐにお支払いします。修正版の請求書は、共用のメールボックスではなく、私のメールアドレス(lucy.chen@harperarch.example)宛にお送りください。よろしくお願いします。
オフィスマネージャー ルーシー・チェン

title: Article: Brewery expands overseas
passage:
HILLSDALE — Stonebridge Brewing, a small craft brewery founded in Hillsdale eight years ago, announced on Monday that it will begin exporting its beer to Japan and South Korea this autumn. The company started in a rented garage with a single fermentation tank, and it now produces about 4,000 barrels a year. Its most popular product is a pale ale brewed with local hops. — [1] —

The company's owners, siblings Mark and Laura Bennett, said the decision followed a trade fair in Tokyo last year, where their seasonal fruit beers attracted strong interest from restaurant buyers. — [2] — To meet the expected demand, Stonebridge will install two new fermentation tanks and hire six additional staff members. The tanks will arrive in July, and production is expected to double by the end of the year. The new tanks will also make it possible to brew a second seasonal beer in the summer.

Exporting is not without risk. Shipping costs have risen sharply, and the brewery will need to adjust its labels to meet each country's regulations. Currency changes could also make the beers more expensive for buyers in Japan and Korea. — [3] — Ms. Bennett, however, is confident. "Our beers are made in small batches with local ingredients, and that is exactly what customers overseas are looking for," she said. The brewery has already signed a contract with a freight company that has experience in Asian markets. Ms. Bennett said the company will review its shipping plans every month to keep costs under control.

Stonebridge's beers are currently sold in about 120 bars and shops in the region. Its largest customer is a supermarket chain that stocks the lager all year round. — [4] — The company also plans to open a small visitor center at the brewery next year. Tours will be free for groups of up to ten people. Bookings can be made online or by telephone, and the first tours begin in the spring. The company's bottles are sold in 330-milliliter and 500-milliliter sizes.
translation:
ヒルズデール発 ― 8年前にヒルズデールで創業した小さなクラフトビール醸造所ストーンブリッジ・ブルーイングは月曜日、この秋から日本と韓国にビールの輸出を始めると発表した。同社は借りたガレージで、発酵タンク1基から始めた。現在は年間約4,000バレルを生産しており、主力商品は地元のホップを使ったペールエールだ。

経営者のマーク・ベネットさんとローラ・ベネットさんの兄妹によれば、昨年東京の見本市で季節限定のフルーツビールが飲食店の仕入れ担当者から強い関心を集めたことを受けて決めたという。実際、見本市の後、数社の輸入業者から連絡があった。見込まれる需要に応えるため、ストーンブリッジは発酵タンクを2基増設し、従業員を6人追加で雇う。タンクは7月に届く予定で、年末までに生産量は2倍になる見込みだ。新しいタンクがあれば、夏にも季節限定ビールを醸造できるようになる。

輸出にはリスクもある。輸送費は急騰しており、各国の規制に合わせてラベルも変更しなければならない。為替の変動によって、日本や韓国の買い手にとってビールが割高になることもありうる。しかしローラさんは自信を見せる。「当社のビールは地元の原料を使って少量ずつ作っています。それこそが海外のお客さまが求めているものです」同社はすでに、アジア市場での経験がある貨物輸送会社と契約を結んでいる。ベネットさんによれば、同社は費用を抑えるため、輸送計画を毎月見直す方針だ。

ストーンブリッジのビールは現在、地域の約120のバーや店で販売されている。最大の取引先は、このラガーを一年中置いているスーパーマーケットチェーンだ。同社は来年、醸造所に小さな見学者センターを開く予定でもある。見学ツアーは10人までのグループなら無料になる予定だ。予約はオンラインまたは電話で受け付けており、最初のツアーは春に始まる。ビールの瓶は330ミリリットルと500ミリリットルの2種類で売られている。

title: Double passage: Volunteer notice and sign-up form
passage:
【Document 1: Notice】
Clearwater Community Garden — Spring Planting Day
Saturday, April 12, 9:00 A.M. – 1:00 P.M.
Location: Clearwater Community Garden, 14 Mill Road, behind the public library

We need volunteers for the following tasks:
- Preparing soil beds (requires lifting heavy bags)
- Planting seedlings
- Painting the new tool shed
- Serving lunch to volunteers
- Weeding the flower beds

No experience is necessary. Tools and gloves will be provided. Volunteers under 16 must be accompanied by an adult. Children are welcome to help with planting, but everyone under 16 must have an adult with them. Please sign up by April 5. Volunteers will be divided into small teams, and each team will have a leader who will show you what to do. Lunch will be served at 12:30 P.M. in the picnic area, and vegetarian and gluten-free options will be available. Parking on Mill Road is limited, so please carpool or use the bicycle racks at the north gate. In case of rain, the event will be moved to the following Saturday. Please bring a water bottle and a hat, as the garden is outdoors and there is little shade. For more information, contact Ruth Okafor at the garden office, 555-0148. Ruth will also explain how to get to the garden from the bus stop on Oak Avenue, which is a five-minute walk.

The garden was founded in 2009 by local residents who wanted fresh vegetables for families in the neighborhood. Today it has more than 80 plots, a small orchard, and a children's reading corner. Last year, volunteers planted more than 1,200 seedlings, and the harvest was donated to the food bank.

【Document 2: Sign-up form】
Name: Karen Douglas
Number in group: 3 (myself and my two children, ages 9 and 12)
Preferred task(s): Planting seedlings, serving lunch
Comments: I recently had back surgery, so I'm unable to lift anything heavy. My children are very excited to help in the garden! I would love to help with planting, and my children can work beside me with the seedlings. My neighbor told me the garden is a wonderful place to meet people, and I am looking forward to it. The notice says tools and gloves are provided, and that is very helpful for us. We are a family of three, and this is our first time volunteering together. The children have been reading about gardening at school, and they want to learn how to grow tomatoes. I hope we can also take home a few seedlings for our own balcony garden.
Phone: 555-0193 (please call to confirm)
Email: karen.douglas@example.com
Date submitted: April 7

場所:クリアウォーター地域菜園(ミル通り14番地、公立図書館の裏)

title: Double passage: Job advertisement and cover letter
passage:
【Document 1: Job advertisement】
Marlow Publishing seeks an Assistant Editor for its children's books division.
Location: 40 Harbor Street, Boston. The position is full-time, with three days a week in the office and two days working from home.
Responsibilities: reviewing manuscripts, communicating with authors and illustrators, and checking final proofs.
Requirements: a bachelor's degree in English or a related field; at least two years of editing experience.
Preferred: experience working on children's books; ability to read French.
Marlow Publishing has produced picture books, early readers, and novels for young adults since 1982. The company is known for careful editing and high-quality illustrations. The team works closely with authors and illustrators to produce books that are both educational and fun to read.
Applications should include a résumé and a short writing sample. Send them to jobs@marlowpub.com by May 31. Interviews will be held in June, and the successful candidate is expected to start on July 15.
Benefits include health insurance, a retirement plan, and a book allowance for staff members. Dress code: smart casual.

【Document 2: Cover letter】
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Assistant Editor position. I graduated with a degree in English literature three years ago and have since worked as an editor for a travel magazine, where I review articles and correspond with writers and photographers. I enjoy working closely with authors, and I have learned how important clear, careful editing is to a good final product.

Although I have not edited children's books professionally, I have volunteered at my local library for two years, reading to children and helping to select new titles. The children I read to are always eager to hear new stories, and that has shown me how much a book can matter to a young reader. At the library, I also organized a monthly book club for children aged six to ten, which taught me how to choose books that are appealing and age-appropriate. I also spent a year studying in Lyon, so I can read French comfortably. My time there also gave me a better sense of how French readers respond to stories. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss the position in person, and I am available for an interview at any time after May 15. I believe I would bring a fresh perspective to the team.

As requested, I have attached my résumé and a sample article. My résumé also includes details of my work at the library. The sample is a 900-word feature about a family-run bakery, which I wrote for the magazine last spring.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to hearing from you.

Sincerely,
Nadia Hassan
translation:
【文書1:求人広告】マーロウ出版は児童書部門の編集アシスタントを募集します。勤務地はボストンのハーバー通り40番地です。週3日は出社、2日は在宅勤務となるフルタイムです。業務:原稿の確認、作家・イラストレーターとの連絡、最終校正の確認。必須条件:英語または関連分野の学士号、2年以上の編集経験。歓迎:児童書の仕事の経験、フランス語の読解力。マーロウ出版は1982年の創業以来、絵本、初級読本、ヤングアダルト向けの小説を出版してきました。丁寧な編集と質の高いイラストで知られています。チームは作家やイラストレーターと密接に働き、教育的でおもしろく読める本を作っています。応募には履歴書と短い文章見本を添えて、5月31日までにメールで送ってください。面接は6月に行われ、採用された方は7月15日からの勤務を予定しています。福利厚生には医療保険、退職金制度、職員向けの書籍手当てが含まれます。服装は、きちんとしたカジュアル(スマートカジュアル)です。

【文書2:カバーレター】編集アシスタント職に応募いたします。3年前に英文学の学位を取って卒業し、それ以来、旅行雑誌の編集者として記事の確認や、ライター・写真家とのやり取りをしてきました。私は作家と密接に働くことが好きで、明確で丁寧な編集が良い作品にとってどれほど大切かを学んできました。
児童書を仕事で編集したことはありませんが、地元の図書館で2年間ボランティアをし、子どもへの読み聞かせや新刊の選定を手伝ってきました。図書館では、子どもたちがいつも新しいお話を楽しみにしてくれ、本が若い読者にとってどれほど大切かを実感しています。図書館では、6歳から10歳の子どもを対象にした月例の読書会も企画しました。そこで、魅力的で年齢に合った本の選び方を学びました。また、リヨンで1年間学んだのでフランス語を問題なく読めます。その地で過ごした時間は、フランスの読者が物語にどう反応するかを理解する助けにもなりました。面接の機会をいただければ幸いです。5月15日以降であればいつでも伺えます。チームに新しい視点をもたらせると考えています。
ご指示の通り、履歴書と記事の見本を添付しました。履歴書には、図書館での活動の詳細も記載しています。見本は、昨年春に雑誌のために書いた、家族経営のパン屋に関する900語の特集記事です。ご検討いただきありがとうございます。ご連絡をお待ちしています。ナディア・ハッサン

title: Double passage: Product manual excerpt and support chat
passage:
【Document 1: Manual excerpt】
AquaPure Water Filter — Troubleshooting
Before you begin, turn off the water supply to the filter.
• Water flows slowly: The filter cartridge may be clogged. Replace the cartridge (recommended every 3 months).
• Water tastes unusual: Run water through the new cartridge for 5 minutes before drinking.
• Red light is blinking: The filter needs to be reset. Hold the power button for 10 seconds.
• Leaking from the base: Check that the cartridge is firmly locked in place. If leaking continues, contact customer support.
Write the installation date on the cartridge box so you can track when it needs replacing. Use only AquaPure replacement cartridges, which are tested for your model.
Warranty: The AquaPure filter is covered by a two-year limited warranty from the date of purchase. Parts such as the base seal and the housing are covered.
Keep the filter away from direct sunlight, and never use hot water. Clean the outside of the base with a soft, damp cloth once a month. Do not use harsh chemicals or abrasive pads. If the filter has been unused for more than two weeks, run water for two minutes before using it.
Customer support is available Monday to Friday, 8:00 A.M. to 6:00 P.M., and on Saturdays from 9:00 A.M. to noon. Visit aquapure.example/support or call the number on the box.

【Document 2: Online chat】
Customer (Leo Brandt, 7:42 P.M.): Hi, I installed a new cartridge in my AquaPure filter this afternoon, but now water is leaking from the bottom.
Agent (Ruth, 7:43 P.M.): I'm sorry to hear that. Have you checked that the cartridge is locked in properly?
Customer (7:45 P.M.): Yes, I removed it and put it back twice. It's still leaking.
Agent (7:46 P.M.): Thank you for checking. In that case, the seal on the base may be damaged. Since your filter is still under warranty, we'll send you a replacement base free of charge. Could you confirm your address?
Customer (7:48 P.M.): Yes, it's 18 Pine Court, Denver, Colorado 80203. I bought the filter last March, so it should still be covered.
Agent (7:49 P.M.): Thank you, Mr. Brandt. The replacement base usually arrives within five business days. Until then, please turn off the water supply to the filter to avoid more leaks.
Customer (7:51 P.M.): That sounds good. Thanks for your help, Ruth.
Agent (7:52 P.M.): You're welcome, Mr. Brandt. We're sorry for the trouble. You will also receive an email with a tracking number, and you can check the delivery status on our website.
Customer (7:53 P.M.): Thank you. I'll wait for the email.
translation:
【文書1:取扱説明書(抜粋)】アクアピュア浄水器 ― 困ったときは
作業を始める前に、フィルターへの水の供給を止めてください。
・水の出が悪い:カートリッジが詰まっている可能性があります。交換してください(3か月ごとを推奨)。
・水の味がいつもと違う:新しいカートリッジに5分間水を流してから飲んでください。
・赤いランプが点滅:フィルターのリセットが必要です。電源ボタンを10秒間押してください。
・底から水漏れ:カートリッジがしっかり固定されているか確認してください。それでも漏れる場合はカスタマーサポートにご連絡ください。
交換日は、カートリッジの箱に書いておくと交換時期がわかりやすくなります。交換用のカートリッジは、お使いの機種向けに試験済みのアクアピュア純正品のみをお使いください。
保証:アクアピュアの浄水器は、購入日から2年間の限定保証があります。底部のパッキンや本体部品も対象です。
直射日光を避け、お湯は絶対に使わないでください。底の外側は、月に1回やわらかい湿った布で拭いてください。強い薬品やたわしは使わないでください。2週間以上使わなかった場合は、使う前に2分間水を流してください。
カスタマーサポートは月曜から金曜の午前8時から午後6時、土曜は午前9時から正午まで対応しています。aquapure.example/support をご覧になるか、箱に記載の番号にお電話ください。

【文書2:オンラインチャット】客(レオ・ブラント、午後7時42分):今日の午後、アクアピュアに新しいカートリッジを入れたのですが、底から水が漏れるんです。
担当(ルース、午後7時43分):申し訳ございません。カートリッジがきちんと固定されているか確認されましたか。
客(午後7時45分):はい、2回外して付け直しました。まだ漏れます。
担当(午後7時46分):ご確認ありがとうございます。その場合、本体底部のパッキンが損傷している可能性があります。保証期間内ですので、交換用の底部を無料でお送りします。ご住所を確認させていただけますか。
客(午後7時48分):はい、コロラド州デンバーのパイン・コート18番地、80203です。フィルターは去年の3月に買ったので、まだ保証が効くはずですよね。
担当(午後7時49分):ブラントさん、ありがとうございます。交換用の底部は通常5営業日以内に届きます。それまでは、これ以上漏れないようフィルターへの水の供給を止めておいてください。
客(午後7時51分):わかりました。ルースさん、ありがとう。
担当(午後7時52分):どういたしまして、ブラントさん。ご不便をおかけして申し訳ありません。追跡番号つきのメールもお送りしますので、配送状況は当社のウェブサイトでご確認いただけます。
客(午後7時53分):ありがとうございます。メールを待ちます。

Gates open at 11:00 A.M., and the last entry is at 7:30 P.M.
Food court seating for 500 guests, with shaded tables near the lake.
Free water refill stations are available near every food area.
Festival volunteers are available at every entrance to answer questions and help visitors find their way.
Food vendors are inspected by the city health department, and all dishes are labeled with allergy information.
Admission tickets are non-refundable, and each ticket is valid for one day only.
Festival hours may change in case of severe weather; check the website for updates.
Buy admission online by June 14 and save $2!

【Document 2: E-mail】
From: Tina Morales
To: Paul Morales
Date: June 10
Subject: Food festival

Hi Paul,
I bought our admission tickets online today, so we're all set. The website was easy to use, and it showed the $2 discount right away. I didn't buy any tasting tickets yet—we can get those at the park. Apparently the booths sell them until the festival closes at eight. I'd like to arrive around four so we can try some food before the music starts. The kids have been asking about the face painting, so I think they'll love the Children's Corner. The kids want to bring their drawing books, so please remind them. Let me know if that works for you and the kids. If you can't make it by four, we can meet near the main stage at five instead. I'll bring the camera too, so we can take photos of the kids at the Children's Corner. Paul, let me know if you think we should bring a blanket for sitting on the grass. I also packed some sunscreen and water bottles. Mrs. Lee from next door said she might join us if the weather is nice.
Tina

title: Double passage: Memo and reply about office move
passage:
【Document 1: Memo】
To: All Staff
From: Facilities Manager, Greta Olsen
Date: September 2

As announced, our office will move from the fourth floor to the newly renovated seventh floor of the same building over the weekend of September 20–21. The renovation includes new meeting rooms, a larger kitchen, and quiet rooms for phone calls. Please pack the contents of your desk into the boxes provided by 5:00 P.M. on Friday, September 19, and label each box with your name and new desk number. Anything you no longer need can be placed in the recycling bins on the third floor. Please also clear your desktop of personal items and check that all drawers are empty. Computers will be moved by the IT team; please do not pack them yourself. IT will disconnect each computer, so please save your work and shut down your machine before you leave on Friday. The new desk assignments are posted on the intranet. If you have questions about your assignment, please contact me by e-mail or visit my office on the fourth floor. Office supplies that are not needed will be collected by the facilities team on September 20. Moving day will begin at 8:00 A.M. on Saturday, September 20, and the building entrance will be closed to visitors. Facilities will provide a moving checklist on the intranet by September 10. Thank you for your cooperation, and please feel free to ask questions.

【Document 2: E-mail】
From: Hiroshi Tanaka
To: Greta Olsen
Date: September 4
Subject: Office move

Hi Greta,
Thank you for the memo. The plan looks well organized, and I appreciate the clear instructions. I'll be at a client site in Toronto from September 17 to September 24, so I won't be able to pack my desk on the 19th. Would it be possible for me to pack everything on September 16 instead? I have already started sorting my files, so the packing should not take long. Also, I noticed that my new desk number isn't listed on the intranet yet. Could you send it to me by e-mail so I can label my boxes before I leave? I also wanted to ask whether I can keep my current chair until the new one is delivered. I will take the earliest flight back from Toronto on September 24 and will be in the office on the morning of September 25 to check my new desk. If the move date changes, please let me know, and I will adjust my plans with my client. I will also share the new floor plan with my team, so they know where to find me.
Best,
Hiroshi
translation:
【文書1:社内連絡】宛先:全社員/差出人:施設管理責任者グレタ・オルセン/9月2日
お知らせの通り、9月20日・21日の週末に、同じビルの4階から改装したばかりの7階へ事務所を移転します。改装では、新しい会議室、広めの給湯室、電話用の静かな部屋が設けられます。9月19日(金)午後5時までに、机の中身を配布した箱に詰め、各箱に名前と新しい机の番号を書いてください。必要のないものは、3階のリサイクル用ボックスに入れてください。机の上の私物を片付け、引き出しがすべて空になっているかご確認ください。パソコンは IT チームが運びますので、ご自分で梱包しないでください。IT チームは各パソコンの接続を外すので、金曜日に退社する前に作業を保存し、電源を切ってください。新しい座席表は社内ネットに掲載しています。座席について質問があれば、私にメールするか、4階の事務室まで来てください。不要な備品は、9月20日に施設チームが回収します。引っ越しの当日は9月20日(土)午前8時に始まり、ビルの入口は来訪者に対して閉鎖されます。引っ越しのチェックリストは、9月10日までに社内ネットに掲載します。ご協力ありがとうございます。ご質問があれば、遠慮なくお寄せください。

【文書2:メール】グレタさん
社内連絡をありがとうございます。計画がよく整理されていて、指示も明確で助かります。9月17日から24日までトロントの顧客先にいるので、19日に机を梱包できません。代わりに9月16日にすべて梱包してもいいでしょうか。もう書類の整理は始めているので、梱包にはそれほど時間はかからないと思います。また、社内ネットにまだ私の新しい机の番号が載っていないようです。箱にラベルを貼れるよう、出発前にメールで番号を教えていただけますか。今の椅子を新しい椅子が届くまで使い続けてもよいかについても、伺いたいと思っていました。24日にトロントから一番早い便で戻り、25日の朝に新しい机を確認しに出社する予定です。移転日が変わったら教えてください。顧客とも相談して予定を調整します。新しいフロアマップもチームに共有して、私の居場所がわかるようにしておきます。
ヒロシ
